描述_EN: this candlestick is an example of yaozhou wares typical of the northern song dynasty (960-1127). while the wares produced at the yaozhou kiln complex enjoyed popularity from the end of the tang dynasty (960-1127) through to the beginning of the yuan dynasty (1279-1368), this candlestick is typical of the yaozhou wares of the northern song period in its stoneware body and olive green glaze. when applied to the formed surface of the candlestick, the glaze pooled into the crevices of the clay and ran thin over any raised areas and at the edges. after firing, areas where the glaze ran thick were an opaque olive green and thin areas emerged a paler hue, heightening effect of the actual relief. glaze was an important tool in the design of yaozhou wares.
描述_ZN: 此烛台是北宋时期典型的耀州器皿的一个例子（960-1127）。 从唐朝末年（960-1127）到元朝初年（1279-1368），耀州窑群生产的器物都很受欢迎，这个烛台是北宋时期耀州器物的典型，它的石器身和橄榄绿釉。 当应用于烛台的成型表面时，釉料积聚在泥土的缝隙中，并在任何凸起的地方和边缘处流淌着薄薄的釉。 烧制后，釉面厚的地方是不透明的橄榄绿，薄的地方出现了较淡的色调，加强了实际的浮雕效果。 釉料是耀州器物设计中的重要工具。
